item.name: Jidi Pollen Bag

effects.title: Pollinate
effects.text: Spreads pollen on all enemy units in a 900 unit radius for 9 seconds, decreasing their health restoration by 50% and dealing damage per second, the total equal to 9% of their maximum health.

notes: Damage is non-lethal and classified as HP Loss.
item.lore: Very dangerous. Very difficult to obtain more.
